title: Dedicated fleet occupancy insights and prescriptive actions
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Goal: Provide a telemetry-driven service that surfaces per-pool occupancy and throughput guarantees, simulates autoscale policy outcomes, and produces actionable right-size and autoscaling recommendations for Dedicated fleets.

Problem statement:
- Customers often over-provision dedicated pools to avoid SLA breaches; this increases monthly commitments and CO2/cost.
- Existing dashboards show raw utilization but do not translate signals into prescriptive actions (how many slots to remove, recommended burst configs, or policy edits).

Scope and deliverables (MVP):
1) Occupancy and throughput signal enrichment: additional telemetry for tenant-level p99 token latency under different sequence-length quantiles, slot occupancy per GPU, KV cache hit-rate correlated with request mix.
2) Simulation engine: lightweight policy simulator that replays a 30-day window and outputs estimated SLO breach probability under candidate autoscale policies and right-size proposals.
3) Recommendation API: /v1/dedicated/recommendations returning ranked actions (e.g., reduce slots by N, set min_scale to X, enable burst to Y) with estimated monthly savings and breach risk delta.
4) Console integration: new "Optimize" tab per-pool showing suggested actions, confidence scores, and "what-if" slider for risk tolerance.

Trade-offs and decisions so far:
- Accuracy vs complexity: initial simulator will be deterministic and replay-based (no ML) to provide transparent explanations; a follow-up ML ranking model may be added.
- Observation window: MVP uses 30 days; operations asked for 90-day rollups for seasonality—post-MVP follow-up.
- Billing alignment: cost estimates approximate using slot-hour rates and observed throughput; finance will sign off before tenant-facing dollar estimates.

Acceptance criteria:
- Enriched telemetry is ingested and queryable in the internal observability store for 95% of dedicated pools.
- Simulator produces recommendations for >= 80% of pools with stable data and returns results within 20s for a 30-day replay.
- Recommendations have estimated monthly savings and a quantified breach probability delta.
- Console UI shows recommendations and allows users to apply safe, canary, or manual modes.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry enrichment available and queryable for 95% of pools
Simulator returns recommendations within 20s for 30-day windows
Recommendations include estimated monthly savings and breach probability delta
